The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. The CDR/TDR/FDR amounting to Rs 15236/- should be upload and orginal one shall be submitted in the office of undersigned . 11 Reverse Auction (RA) Special Terms & Conditions ​Applicability of Reverse Auction: ​The buyer/procuring entity reserves the right to conduct a Reverse Auction (RA) on the GeM Portal after th e technical evaluation of bids. ​Only technically qualified bidders who meet the eligibility criteria and technical specifications for the Physi cal Training Items (Yoga Mats & Skipping Ropes) will be allowed to participate in the Reverse Auction. ​RA Rules & Process: ​Base Price: The starting price for the Reverse Auction will be set based on the lowest financial bid (L_1) rec eived during the initial tender submission, provided it is within the total sanctioned ceiling of ₹7,61,800/-. ​Decrement Value: The minimum price decrement step and auction duration will be defined on the GeM Por tal at the time of initiating the RA. ​Auto-Extension: If a bidder submits a lower bid within the final minutes of the auction, the RA timer will aut omatically extend as per standard GeM RA rules. ​Elimination / Qualification Rule: ​As per GeM guidelines, the buyer may enforce the H_1 elimination rule (where the highest bidder is exclud ed from RA if the total number of qualified bidders exceeds the minimum threshold specified on the portal) . ​Reasonability of Rates (ROR) Post-RA: ​Participation or winning in the Reverse Auction does not automatically guarantee contract award. ​The final L_1 rate obtained through RA remains subject to verification of Reasonability of Rates (ROR) unde r Rule 149 of GFR, 2017 to ensure the price is fair, reasonable, and not higher than prevailing market rates. ​Bid Validity & System Disruption: ​In the event of any technical failure or system outage on the GeM platform during the Reverse Auction pro cess, the auction may be extended or rescheduled at the discretion of the competent authority / GeM Admi
